name: Aegon I Targaryen
titles: King of the Andals, the Rhoynar, and the First Men
description: The founder of the Targaryen dynasty. Aegon, riding the black dragon Balerion, conquered and unified six of the Seven Kingdoms of Westeros.

timeline.event: Crowned at Oldtown, Aegon establishes his capital at King's Landing and begins building the kingdom.

name: Visenya Targaryen
description: The elder sister-wife of Aegon I. A fierce warrior, she rode the dragon Vhagar, wielded the Valyrian steel sword Dark Sister, and oversaw the conquest of the Vale.

timeline.event: Assists Aegon in administration and designs the Kingsguard protection.

name: Rhaenys Targaryen
description: The younger, more playful sister-wife of Aegon I. She rode the dragon Meraxes, loved music and poetry, and helped win the Stormlands.

timeline.event: Patronizes singers and fosters diplomatic ties across the realm.

name: Orys Baratheon
description: Aegon's close friend and rumored half-brother. Orys slew King Argilac, married his daughter Argella, and became the first Hand of the King and founder of House Baratheon.

timeline.event: Rules the Stormlands from Storm's End and serves as Aegon's primary commander.

name: Torrhen Stark
description: The last King in the North. Torrhen Stark marched a large army south to fight Aegon but bent the knee after seeing the scale of Targaryen forces and dragons.

timeline.event: Enforces the peace of the Dragon in the North, facing some political backlash from his brothers.

name: Loren I Lannister
description: The last King of the Rock. He allied with Mern Gardener to fight Aegon on the Field of Fire, escaped the blaze, submitted, and was named Warden of the West.

timeline.event: Integrates the Westerlands into the royal economy, resuming gold flow.

name: Edmyn Tully
description: The first Tully Lord Paramount. Edmyn led the Riverlands rebellion against King Harren the Black, swearing fealty to Aegon before Harrenhal burned.

timeline.event: Accepts fealty from the other river lords, pacifying the central kingdoms.

name: Harlan Tyrell
description: The high steward of Highgarden who yielded the castle to Aegon after House Gardener was extinguished. Aegon rewarded his surrender with the castle and rule of the Reach.

timeline.event: Consolidates his rule over the Reach, facing coldness from Florents and Oakhearts.

name: Ronnel Arryn
description: The boy king who surrendered the Vale. When Queen Visenya flew Vhagar to the Eyrie, Ronnel was found sitting on her lap, asking if he could ride the dragon.

timeline.event: Ronnel rules the Vale under the regency of his mother, Sharra Arryn.

name: Sharra Arryn
description: The regent who ruled the Vale for her young son Ronnel. Known as the 'Flower of the Vale', she submitted after Visenya flew over their defenses.

timeline.event: Assists her son in governing the mountain clans and sea ports.

name: Vickon Greyjoy
description: The first Greyjoy ruler of the Iron Islands. Vickon was elected by the ironborn lords in 2 AC after Aegon executed the remaining Hoares.

timeline.event: Appointed by election, Vickon enforces royal laws and discourages reaving.

name: Meria Martell
description: The eighty-year-old, blind ruler of Dorne who resisted Aegon. She told Rhaenys that Dorne would fight and refuse to bend, successfully holding off the dragons.

timeline.event: Refuses Rhaenys' terms of surrender, declaring Dorne will stay sovereign.

name: Daemon Velaryon
description: Aegon's first Master of Ships. He commanded the fleet during the conquest and was slain by Arryn forces at the battle in Gulltown harbor.

timeline.event: Slain in the Gulltown naval combat.

name: Crispian Celtigar
description: A Valyrian nobleman who served as Aegon's first Master of Coin, establishing the realm's taxation and treasury systems.

timeline.event: Manages treasury operations and taxes for the newly unified Seven Kingdoms.

name: Aenys I Targaryen
titles: King of the Andals, the Rhoynar, and the First Men
description: The son of Aegon I and Rhaenys. A weak and indecisive king whose reign was troubled by the Faith Militant uprising.

timeline.event: Succeeds Aegon I as King of the Seven Kingdoms.

name: Maegor I Targaryen
titles: King of the Andals, the Rhoynar, and the First Men
description: The son of Aegon I and Visenya. A brutal tyrant who completed the Red Keep and crushed the Faith Militant with dragonfire.

timeline.event: Seizes the Iron Throne from his nephew Aegon.

name: Jaehaerys I Targaryen
titles: King of the Andals, the Rhoynar, and the First Men
description: The longest-reigning Targaryen king. His wise rule brought fifty-five years of peace and prosperity to the Seven Kingdoms.

timeline.event: Succeeds Maegor I and begins a long era of peace and reconciliation.

name: Viserys I Targaryen
titles: King of the Andals, the Rhoynar, and the First Men
description: A peaceful king whose reign was marked by prosperity but whose succession dispute between his daughter Rhaenyra and son Aegon II led to the Dance of the Dragons.

timeline.event: Succeeds Jaehaerys I peacefully.

name: Rhaenyra Targaryen
description: Daughter of Viserys I, she was named heir to the Iron Throne but was challenged by her half-brother Aegon II, sparking the Dance of the Dragons.

timeline.event: Claims the Iron Throne, beginning the Dance of the Dragons.

name: Aegon II Targaryen
titles: King of the Andals, the Rhoynar, and the First Men
description: The son of Viserys I and Alicent Hightower. He usurped the Iron Throne from his half-sister Rhaenyra, sparking the devastating Dance of the Dragons civil war.

timeline.event: Crowned in the Dragonpit, seizing the throne and sparking the Dance of the Dragons.

name: Aegon III Targaryen
titles: King of the Andals, the Rhoynar, and the First Men
description: The son of Rhaenyra Targaryen. He witnessed his mother's death by dragonfire and became king after the Dance. The last dragon died during his reign.

timeline.event: Succeeds Aegon II, ending the Dance of the Dragons.

name: Daeron I Targaryen
titles: King of the Andals, the Rhoynar, and the First Men
description: The eldest son of Aegon III. He conquered Dorne at age fourteen but was killed in the subsequent Dornish rebellion at age eighteen.

timeline.event: Succeeds Aegon III and conquers Dorne.

name: Baelor I Targaryen
titles: King of the Andals, the Rhoynar, and the First Men
description: A deeply pious king who walked barefoot to Dorne to make peace. He imprisoned his own sisters in the Maidenvault and starved himself to death through fasting.

timeline.event: Succeeds Daeron I. Walks barefoot to Dorne to make peace.

name: Viserys II Targaryen
titles: King of the Andals, the Rhoynar, and the First Men
description: Uncle to Daeron I and Baelor I. An able administrator who served as Hand of the King for years before finally ascending the throne himself, ruling for only a year.

timeline.event: Succeeds Baelor I. Rules capably for one year before his death.

name: Aegon IV Targaryen
titles: King of the Andals, the Rhoynar, and the First Men
description: Widely regarded as the worst Targaryen king. His legitimization of all his bastards on his deathbed led to the Blackfyre Rebellions that plagued the realm for generations.

timeline.event: Succeeds Viserys II. His corrupt reign destabilizes the realm.

name: Daeron II Targaryen
titles: King of the Andals, the Rhoynar, and the First Men
description: A wise and diplomatic king who peacefully united Dorne with the Seven Kingdoms through marriage. He defeated the First Blackfyre Rebellion but died in the Great Spring Sickness.

timeline.event: Succeeds Aegon the Unworthy. Unites Dorne through marriage.

name: Aerys I Targaryen
titles: King of the Andals, the Rhoynar, and the First Men
description: A bookish and disinterested king who left governance to his Hand, Brynden 'Bloodraven' Rivers. His reign saw the Second Blackfyre Rebellion.

timeline.event: Succeeds Daeron II. Leaves governance to Bloodraven.

name: Maekar I Targaryen
titles: King of the Andals, the Rhoynar, and the First Men
description: A stern warrior-king and fourth son of Daeron II. He died fighting in the Peake Uprising, leading to a Great Council to choose his successor.

timeline.event: Succeeds Aerys I. Rules as a stern but capable king.

name: Aegon V Targaryen
titles: King of the Andals, the Rhoynar, and the First Men
description: The fourth son of a fourth son, chosen by a Great Council. He championed the rights of the smallfolk and died in the Tragedy at Summerhall trying to hatch dragon eggs.

timeline.event: Elected by a Great Council. Champions the smallfolk.

name: Jaehaerys II Targaryen
titles: King of the Andals, the Rhoynar, and the First Men
description: A frail but wise king who succeeded his father Aegon V after the Tragedy at Summerhall. He won the War of the Ninepenny Kings.

timeline.event: Succeeds Aegon V after Summerhall. Wins the War of the Ninepenny Kings.

name: Aerys II Targaryen
titles: King of the Andals, the Rhoynar, and the First Men
description: The last Targaryen king, known as the Mad King. His cruelty and paranoia led to Robert's Rebellion. He was slain by his own Kingsguard, Jaime Lannister.

timeline.event: Succeeds Jaehaerys II. His reign begins well but descends into madness.

name: Robert Baratheon
titles: King of the Andals, the Rhoynar, and the First Men
description: The leader of Robert's Rebellion who overthrew the Mad King Aerys II. A great warrior but an indifferent ruler, his death plunged the realm into the War of the Five Kings.

timeline.event: Wins Robert's Rebellion and claims the Iron Throne.

name: Joffrey Baratheon
titles: King of the Andals, the Rhoynar, and the First Men
description: The eldest son of Cersei Lannister, publicly claimed as Robert's heir. A cruel and capricious boy-king whose reign saw the War of the Five Kings. Murdered at his own wedding feast.

timeline.event: Ascends the Iron Throne after Robert's death.
